# stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer (Data Source)

A trial period a price offers before it transitions to another price. `terraform destroy` archives the trial offer, because Stripe cannot delete one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer" "first_month" {
  id = stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer.first_month.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the trial offer can be used for new subscriptions. Defaults to true.
- `duration` (Attributes) Duration of one service period of the trial. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--duration))
- `end_behavior` (Attributes) Define behavior that occurs at the end of the trial. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_behavior))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `nickname` (String) A brief description of the trial offer, hidden from customers.
- `price` (String) Price configuration during the trial period (amount, billing scheme, etc).

<a id="nestedatt--duration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `duration`

Read-Only:

- `relative` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--duration--relative))
- `type` (String) The type of trial offer duration. Possible values: `relative`.

<a id="nestedatt--duration--relative"></a>
### Nested Schema for `duration.relative`

Read-Only:

- `iterations` (Number) The number of iterations of the price's interval for this trial offer.



<a id="nestedatt--end_behavior"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_behavior`

Read-Only:

- `transition` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_behavior--transition))
- `type` (String) The type of behavior when the trial offer ends. Possible values: `transition`.

<a id="nestedatt--end_behavior--transition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_behavior.transition`

Read-Only:

- `price` (String) The new price to use at the end of the trial offer period.
